entry.idea: Endra uses generative AI to design and document the mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems of buildings, work engineers usually do by hand.
entry.lesson: Find a highly technical, slow, manual design process buried inside a huge industry, like construction, and automate the whole workflow.
entry.name: Endra

growth.reason: It moved from a $20M seed to a $50M Series A within about a year and expanded into two new major markets.

market.reason: Every large building needs MEP design, a big, recurring need across the global construction industry.

tech.reason: Automating detailed, code-compliant technical design with generative AI is a hard, specialised problem few teams have solved end to end.

sources.title: Endra secures $20M to automate mechanical, electrical and plumbing design for construction - SiliconANGLE
Endra Expands Into US, UK Following $50m Raise | Plumbing & Mechanical
Exclusive: Notion Capital leads $20 million seed round for startup automating building MEP design | Fortune

entry.twist: It automates the whole MEP design workflow, from layout and device placement to routing and compliance paperwork, not just one small piece of it.
entry.who_pays: Engineering consultancies and construction firms pay to use the platform for MEP design work.
entry.why_now: Construction projects are slowed by a shortage of MEP engineers, and generative AI can now handle detailed technical design work reliably.

mentions.snippet: AI tools for mechanical, electrical and plumbing engineering; launched an agent platform for electrical engineers and acquired Planlabs.
